name: Australasian Bat Society Regular ABS Grants
summary: Small annual grants to members of the Australasian Bat Society for projects that promote the conservation or knowledge of bats in Australasia.

eligibility.rule: Active member of the Australasian Bat Society
No conference travel, travel-led short activities, another body's duties, recurrent funding or salaries

geography.quote: Our regular ABS grants support any projects by members that promote the conservation and/or knowledge of bats in Australasia.

access.quote: Members must submit a completed application form outlining the project's objectives, methodology, timeline, budget details

window.quote: When: A call for applications occurs once a year.

effort.quote: Members must submit a completed application form outlining the project's objectives, methodology, timeline, budget details and contribution to the conservation and/or knowledge of bats in Australasia.
The assessment process will be double-blind, and all applications will be anonymised prior to being passed onto the assessment panel.

eligibility.quote: Remember, you MUST be an active member of the ABS to be eligible to apply for a grant

ABS grants cannot be used for: conference travel; attendance at meetings or other short-term activities mainly involving travel; activities which are properly the responsibility of another organisation or body; recurrent funding of existing projects; or payment of salaries, wages etc.

documents.quote: Please include a copy of your CV with your application.
